raw_posts.name: AgentKit by Scalekit
raw_posts.tagline: MCP gateway for production agents that acts on your behalf
raw_posts.description: Let your agents use 30,000+ tools across 600+ apps, from Salesforce to GitHub, through one MCP gateway. AgentKit handles auth and integrations, so every action runs as the user who asked, within the scopes they granted. Give each agent only the tools its job needs with Virtual MCP Servers. Add internal APIs as custom connectors. Use Triggers to start an agent the moment an email lands. Built for developers taking agents to production: every call is logged. Free tier: 10,000 tool calls a month.

raw_posts.name: Teamily AI

raw_posts.description: The human-agent platform where people and always-on agents get work done together in one unified, context-aware space.
